input_setting: Clinical group summaries supplied; IL-6 and TNF-alpha group summaries withheld; known paper identifiable.
actual_scale: One 27-person pediatric source; two fresh direct 27-row constructions.
comparison: Authored group moments versus published moments.
strongest_supported_finding: Both literal cohorts preserved higher IL-6 and TNF-alpha in MUO than MHO.
numeric_support: Paper contrasts 1.10/1.10; A 0.75/0.56; B 0.54/0.54. Supplied clinical mean median errors 0.05/0.07 source SD.
counterresults: All withheld contrasts attenuated; generated clinical SDs as low as 0.26 of supplied SD.
inference_scope: Prompt withholding does not exclude pretraining exposure; published-summary consistency, not independent patient validation.
paper_role: Early feasibility illustration; do not use as independent discovery.

input_setting: Study design, units, n=12 and pre/post means/sample SDs rounded to3 decimals, freshly computed from public workbook rather than all printed in article; no paired correlations/change SD/CI/p-values or patient rows.
actual_scale: One 12-man, three-day intervention cohort; two direct 12-person paired cohorts; four endpoints.
comparison: Same original paired analyses on measured and generated tables.
strongest_supported_finding: Both constructions retained all four change directions and unadjusted significance classifications; one closely reconstructed leptin change variability.
numeric_support: Leptin real change/SD -2.563/1.534; B -2.567/1.541; paired p 0.0001212 versus 0.0001244.
counterresults: A underestimates change dispersion materially; B underestimates three of four endpoint dispersions.
inference_scope: Within-study reconstruction with disclosed margins and very small male-only sample; p agreement partly input constrained.
paper_role: Concrete true-direct-row precedent; supplementary reconstruction example.

input_setting: Same disclosed pre/post marginal moments for direct authors and ordinary paired Gaussian-copula sampler.
actual_scale: 44 pediatric completers; glucose/TG 43 pairs; two direct constructions; 3,000 ordinary draws across three rho settings.
comparison: Direct rows versus primary rho=0.5 sampler and sensitivity rho=0/0.9.
strongest_supported_finding: Direct rows closely reconstructed margins and body-mass paired dispersion better than the primary fixed-rho comparator.
numeric_support: Body-mass SD(change)/real: A 0.823, B 0.705, ordinary median 6.277.
counterresults: Ordinary comparator closer for three other paired dispersions; both direct cohorts made TG significant when measured data were nonsignificant (p 0.4014 vs 0.04359/0.02300).
inference_scope: One modest source; unknown paired dependence dominates; no consistent direct-author advantage.
paper_role: Counterweight to selected reconstruction successes.

input_setting: He source margins plus newly disclosed within-endpoint pre/post correlations; cross-endpoint relations withheld.
actual_scale: Same 44/43-pair source; two fresh direct authors; one tool planner; 1,000 ordinary draws; unchanged retained direct tables.
comparison: Direct supplied-constraint reconstruction versus ordinary/tool sampling; post-hoc 18 cross-endpoint edges.
strongest_supported_finding: Explicit dependence evidence enables literal rows to reconstruct paired variability very closely.
numeric_support: Direct change-SD/packet ratios: D1 0.9784–1.0036; D2 0.9857–1.0099. Tool planner outputs exactly equal ordinary same-seed rows.
counterresults: No numerical revision occurred. Cross-endpoint rMAE D1 0.4212, D2 0.3292 versus ordinary 0.1903/0.2236.
inference_scope: Supplied correlations mathematically determine paired dispersion; not hidden-outcome recovery or new clinical replication. Review demo reuses H03 data and creates no new Agent run.
paper_role: Mechanistic illustration of what evidence buys; avoid treating p-value reconstruction as independent validation.

input_setting: Outcome-by-sex-stratified counts, means, SDs, seven quantiles and regularized rank correlations from 128 real NHANES 2015–16 participants; no individual author inputs.
actual_scale: 128 real training rows; two literal 128-row cohorts; 100 ordinary cohorts; 1,811 eligible NHANES 2017–18 test participants; two frozen classifiers.
comparison: Real-only training and information-matched ordinary generation, no favorable-seed selection.
strongest_supported_finding: Aggregate-conditioned literal synthetic rows retained useful discrimination for current elevated HbA1c in a later survey cycle.
numeric_support: Logistic AUC: real 0.734936; A1 0.712130; A2 0.726871; ordinary median 0.717394. Brier: real 0.210303; A1 0.216229; A2 0.213445; ordinary 0.215560. Prevalence-only AUC0.5/Brier0.248578. Ordinary AUC generation quantiles0.651048–0.743380; A1/A2 exceed38/67 of100 draws. Weighted logistic AUC real0.742122/A1 0.722713/A2 0.734453/ordinary0.724310.
counterresults: Neither author surpassed real-only AUC/Brier; one author below and one above ordinary AUC median. Both inside ordinary generation interval; no sampling CIs or noninferiority testing; boosting AUC real0.660930/A1 0.634484/A2 0.646883/ordinary0.638858 and Brier0.240598/0.247879/0.242525/0.261487.
inference_scope: Cross-cycle within same survey, current measured threshold not future diabetes; summaries used measured outcome labels; one training draw and two authors; no feedback intervention. Raw HbA1c excluded from five predictors. Training-only StandardScaler; threshold0.5 and both classifier families fixed. Model lock16:14:21.403UTC precedes test download16:14:27.087. Original round0 direct outputs unchanged; only prelock schema/provenance fixes. No formal guarantee against unlogged/pretraining exposure.
paper_role: Strong historical downstream-use example; explicitly summary-conditioned and non-superiority.

input_setting: Source-summary packets computed from public individual data, not automatically extracted paper tables; no target outcome summaries; forecasts frozen.
actual_scale: Population NAGALA n=15,450; intervention DIETFITS n=464; three Agent contexts per arm; three queries per case.
comparison: Direct Agent A versus cohort Agent B versus random-effects C; source-specific references.
strongest_supported_finding: Both Agent arms improved primary association point loss over exchangeable pooling in both cases.
numeric_support: Equal-case primary squared error A 0.001137; B 0.001500; C 0.006246. Population target r 0.3469; B forecasts 0.3291–0.3373.
counterresults: B did not beat A; C better all-query equal-case error (0.004286 vs A 0.005205/B 0.005434); evaluator sex-code repair disclosed.
inference_scope: Only two cases; primary forecasts not necessarily reusable-row superiority; source relevance varies by query; targets now exposed.
paper_role: Support for contextual evidence use, not necessity of a virtual cohort representation.

input_setting: WLM/STRRIDE-PD aggregates; target baseline sex/TG summaries; sequential DIETFITS development feedback.
actual_scale: Previously exposed DIETFITS n=464 split 301 development/163 internal check; four versions, 10,000 simulated rows each.
comparison: Initial versus marginal, conditional-point and uncertainty-informed revisions.
strongest_supported_finding: Agent-authored feedback revisions can improve specific internal-check distribution or event metrics.
numeric_support: Check quantile error 0.3344 initially to 0.1478 after marginal repair; correlation MAE 0.0932 to 0.0829 after point repair; joint-event error 1.62528 to 1.16194 pp for uncertainty revision.
counterresults: Weight–HOMA correlation error rises to 0.13180; round3/round2 intervals include zero for all four differences; versions trade off.
inference_scope: All target already exposed; feedback uses target outcomes; numerical integration rows not new subjects; no external superiority baseline.
paper_role: Development lineage showing real revisions and multidimensional trade-offs.

input_setting: DIETFITS/FIT-MI aggregate sources; FIReWoRk baselines and development weight outcomes only; waist outcomes withheld until lock.
actual_scale: FIReWoRk 400 complete pairs split 260/140; two versions, 10,000 rows each.

numeric_support: Weight quantile error 0.35493→0.10547; waist 0.39592→0.35802; joint-event MAE 7.00→2.85 pp.
counterresults: Waist/event improvement intervals include zero; partial-correlation error worsened 0.26402→0.27015; source/target waist sites differ.
inference_scope: Selected complete clinic-pair population; true additional-variable transfer is mixed, with no anatomical conversion validation.
paper_role: Secondary limited example of unprovided metric improvement; retain relationship failure.

input_setting: Source aggregate joint evidence; all target baselines and development weight-only feedback, no target waist feedback.
actual_scale: Queen's trial 215 complete records, 107 development/108 check; two fixed constructions; generated weight margins matched exactly.
comparison: Person mixture versus common-population construction.
strongest_supported_finding: Separating study-level construction improved held-out partial correlation while holding generated weight margins fixed.
numeric_support: Primary partial-correlation error 0.30897→0.23661 (23.4%); joint-event error 7.981→6.488 pp; real partial r 0.83526 versus 0.52629/0.59865.
counterresults: Waist quantile error 0.40796→0.42724; adjusted slope error 0.04224→0.14317.
inference_scope: One independent study relative to prior FIReWoRk; transductive target-baseline information; contrast changes multiple structural ingredients.
paper_role: A real specific structural improvement; avoid claiming universal joint fidelity.

input_setting: Source aggregates and target baselines; weight-only versus added development waist mean/SD feedback.
actual_scale: CHANGE318 complete participants split159development/159check from428 released; four retained10,000-row cells; no post-check revision.
comparison: Person mixture/common population × weight-only/waist-affine calibration.
strongest_supported_finding: Distributional improvement and a transferred correlation advantage are separable.
numeric_support: Common-population waist quantile error 0.62798→0.25715 (59.1%); partial-correlation error common 0.18725 vs mixture 0.24836.
counterresults: Common adjusted-slope error 0.07996→0.15410; primary joint objective not achieved.

input_setting: Existing source joint summaries repaired; four external papers contextual only, no new fitted external coefficient.

comparison: Old versus joint-block generator.
strongest_supported_finding: Preserving already available source conditional covariance reduced adjusted-relationship errors across three retrospective targets.

inference_scope: Not three new independent confirmations; source representation defect correction on already exposed cases; external equations not fitted.

input_setting: Actual partial FIT/MI paper evidence plus target baseline aggregates; Han relation added after initial freeze.
actual_scale: Historical target subsets 211 development/107 check; one initial and one evidence-linked revision.
comparison: G0 versus G1 across fixed joint-response and regression endpoints.
strongest_supported_finding: One paper addition can improve specific conditional means and regressions with traceable provenance.
numeric_support: Check waist responder error 1.5279→0.7098 cm; slope error 0.0166→0.0104; intercept error 1.9162→0.0598 cm.
counterresults: Primary four-cell TV error worsens 5.0608→11.6473 pp; change interval includes zero; no stable population-reuse improvement.
inference_scope: Previously exposed target, one addition; equation reconstruction not target validation.
paper_role: Narrow positive illustration with primary negative prominently retained.

input_setting: Eight authored evidence/model cases with disclosed constraints; identical critique for continued/fresh reviser.
actual_scale: Three planned reviewer runs; one failed before artifact; two completed; five distinct contexts/seven executed language stages.
comparison: Same-context versus separate-context review/revision.
strongest_supported_finding: Both completed workflows corrected six faulty models and retained two valid models.
numeric_support: 16/24 accepted planned case instances in each workflow; 16/16 conditional on delivered reviews.
counterresults: No added benefit from separate reviewer; 1/3 reviewer delivery failure retained.
inference_scope: Invented cases and known oracle, not clinical data generation evidence.
paper_role: Engineering evidence for review/correction; no clinical count.

input_setting: Three authored simulator memos about one disputed Framingham trial and dependent publications.
actual_scale: Three memos; ten criteria each; initial output cap failed, amended transport retained exact original answers.
comparison: First appraisal versus continued/fresh audits.
strongest_supported_finding: First reviews corrected all seven authored errors while preserving five valid/qualified statements.
numeric_support: Three initial appraisals 10/10 frozen criteria; no added correction from final audits.
counterresults: Incomplete source reading disclosed; third fresh audit introduced minor extraction error; initial transport failed.
inference_scope: Tests evidence interpretation on supplied proposals, not spontaneous failure detection, collaboration advantage or synthetic-patient validity.
paper_role: Source interpretation component only.

input_setting: Ross five-visit marginal summaries; first Agent-written stochastic generator then targeted external evidence acquisition.
actual_scale: 75 people at five visits; twenty retained seeds per version; related reuse of same reference.
comparison: Original paper-question replay and prior versus evidence-revised generator.
strongest_supported_finding: Repeated data support some supplied time contrasts and an unsupplied related-measure correlation; acquisition directly improves one informed relation.
numeric_support: DD100–DD1000 real baseline r 0.644, synthetic median 0.628, MAE 0.078; overall reserved rMAE 0.165590→0.164323 (0.77%).
counterresults: PFS/DD100 MAE 0.271; individual-change score barely changes; overall improvement interval spans zero; weight anomaly affects source SE.
inference_scope: Means disclosed; one reused small cohort; acquisition ledger 10 records is not 10 studies; no all-paper conclusion recovery.
paper_role: Within-study analytical reuse with explicit supplied-versus-reserved split.

input_setting: Same target-derived margins for two fresh authors; external PFS–DD100 relation; no patient rows or query answers.
actual_scale: 75 trajectories, five visits, 1,875 slots; one literal author with 288-cell revision; one program; three unique cohorts despite four lifecycle labels.
comparison: Direct initial/final versus program; later same scientific analyses on unchanged tables.
strongest_supported_finding: Literal full trajectories are operationally feasible; program and direct rows support different useful analyses.
numeric_support: Direct supplied SD error 9.8376%→0.5269%; overall correlation error direct final 0.174937 vs program 0.191165. Program PFS–weight beta 0.1431 vs real 0.1657; direct final 0.3784.
counterresults: Direct repair worsens overall rMAE 0.154140→0.174937; program gives better 3/4 pooled associations despite worse correlation score; both overstate DD associations and significance.
inference_scope: Target margins disclosed; existing cohort; downstream extension post hoc; one lineage per route; unchanged versions duplicates.
paper_role: Strong proof of distinct true direct route; analysis-specific utility, no route winner.

input_setting: Visible observations condition both imputers; one external correlation explicitly not numerically used. Agent sees only first masked input before generic method freeze.
actual_scale: 75-person five-visit cohort; three overlapping masks each hide 54/269 observed follow-up PFS cells; 20 imputations per method/mask; 31 native gaps preserved.
comparison: Agent joint longitudinal imputer versus MICE–PMM versus missing-only; expanded 35-analysis replay.
strongest_supported_finding: Agent imputer improves hidden-cell accuracy and primary coefficient recovery relative to this MICE reference while preserving existing observations and all affected evidence states.
numeric_support: Cell MAE Agent 0.338457/0.327963/0.393704 vs MICE 0.362037/0.382223/0.471975. Primary coefficient mean error Agent 0.044560 vs MICE 0.087097. Affected evidence-state agreement Agent 18/18, MICE 17/18, missing-only 18/18.
counterresults: Missing-only primary error 0.010656, better in 3/3 masks. Agent improves effect discrepancy over missing-only 6/18. 29/35 unchanged outputs are preservation controls. Post-hoc weight influence check does not reverse main conclusion.
inference_scope: One cohort, one Agent model; unequal features/specifications prevent isolating LLM benefit; no demonstrated external-evidence gain or calibrated MI coverage.
paper_role: Useful completion and exact preservation claim; primary utility negative versus no filling must accompany it.

input_setting: Supplied moments from Ross/Travers/He; matched ordinary versus expanded scenario revisions; fixed statistical references.
actual_scale: Three previously exposed sources (75, 12, 44/43); nine initial lineages; 18 paired revisions; 420 cohort draws; 55 reference terms.
comparison: Ordinary revision versus each prespecified scenario, no best-scenario selection or pooling.
strongest_supported_finding: Demonstrates auditable analysis sensitivity to plausible but unreported dependence assumptions.
numeric_support: He persistent/stable alternatives match six-correlation evidence states 41/42, 40/42, 41/42; alternative shared-response scenarios only 0/36, 0/36, 7/36.
counterresults: No recurring accuracy advantage; some scenarios add confident unsupported findings; Travers body-mass SE ratios up to 16.97; given means are reconstruction not validation.
inference_scope: Not 420 studies; 33 given mean terms versus 22 reserved relations; no calibrated inference or independent confirmation.
paper_role: Sensitivity/failure-mode evidence, not headline accuracy.

input_setting: Only target age/sex/BMI rows; six non-NHANES papers searched by clean Agent; no glucose, HOMA, target insulin summaries or analysis answers.
actual_scale: NHANES 2017–18 n=1,700 domain; one Agent lognormal construction; twenty residual draws.
comparison: Same reserved real-versus-generated survey-weighted analyses.
strongest_supported_finding: External evidence can populate an entirely absent biomarker and preserve broad BMI associations, including both sexes.
numeric_support: Adjusted geometric-mean ratio per5 BMI real 1.346 [1.304,1.390], generated median 1.230; all 20 positive with intervals above null. Within-sex all20 positive; male/female medians 1.223/1.233.
counterresults: Curvature contrast real -0.123 vs median 0.003; sex interaction real -0.109 vs 0.006. Fixed common slope/no interaction assumptions explain failure.
inference_scope: One construction and one survey cycle; supported relation transfer not unknown biology; 34,000 virtual values not participants; retired contaminated search context disclosed.
paper_role: Core historical enrichment support with structural limits.

input_setting: Only age/sex/BMI, opaque IDs and metadata; equal literature tools/budgets to ordinary and explicit-gap builders.
actual_scale: NHANES2013–14 4,885-person target; two independent builds per policy; five seeds/stage;40 files but25 unique tables.
comparison: Ordinary capable Agent versus explicit gap/action policy; initial/final.
strongest_supported_finding: All four constructions preserve negative BMI/sex-specific BMI and higher female HDL; independent ordinary Agent retrieves/revises usefully.
numeric_support: Real adjusted BMI -3.916; final medians ordinary -2.935/-3.008, gap -5.380/-3.224. Ordinary1 -2.747→-2.935 after revision.
counterresults: Both gap builders retain identical numerical generators; ordinary1 improves five endpoints/worsens three; age near-flat for three builders; gap-policy superiority unsupported.
inference_scope: Four constructions one cohort; protocol engineering adds no verified quality advantage; preserved directions partly external-evidence constrained.

input_setting: Prior results and briefs supplied to model reviewers.
actual_scale: No new biomedical dataset, generation, or target analysis.
comparison: Research framing recommendations and factual corrections.
strongest_supported_finding: Clarifies three input regimes and separates ordinary capable Agent feasibility from optional multi-Agent policy benefit.
counterresults: Review agreement is not independent experimental confirmation; some reviews lacked repository access.
inference_scope: Not part of scientific experiment denominator.
paper_role: Historical context only.

input_setting: Invented data/evidence; M12-A/B and M17-A contain deliberately specified known generators; M2/M12-C include actual independent Agent construction.
actual_scale: M1 seven-row arithmetic fixture; M2 128 rows/three executions; M12-B 12 source rows/26 trials/56 executions; M12-C one construction/eight executions; M17-A one 128-row complete-cohort fixture.

counterresults: No biomedical accuracy evidence, no Agent superiority; M1 program route only statically inspected; invented successful stopping criteria not clinical thresholds.

input_setting: Real target age/sex/BMI; two curated external source papers; target TG and analysis answers withheld. Separate 128-row fictional retention trial.
actual_scale: NHANES 2017–18 n=2,072; one initial construction/one source-driven revision; five paired residual seeds each.

counterresults: BMI still too strong; sex difference worsens -0.1630→-0.2593 vs -0.1708; interaction target CI spans zero.

input_setting: Inherited M3 final model, same source recipes plus quantile/rank operators; no new target evaluation.

input_setting: Same two external papers, target age/sex/BMI, no target TG or previous target answers.
actual_scale: NHANES2021–23 n=2,660; one Agent/three structures/five draws each;15 tables.

input_setting: Inherited imperfect source-informed TG law; assumed product covariate distribution; prespecified synthetic probe.

input_setting: M7 joint TG literature gap; M9 insulin/HbA1c eligibility/evidence packets; M14 body-fat measurement/transport sources.

input_setting: Observed age/sex/BMI and external joint Tromso ratios; source-only construction; withheld fasting TG.

input_setting: Age/sex/BMI/fasting glucose observed; external sources; insulin entirely withheld; no autonomous retrieval.

input_setting: Twenty supplied moments from one Bogalusa paper; four urate SDs withheld; all age/BMI/urate/race/sex fictional.

input_setting: Real fixed age/sex/race/BMI rows; three originals/two recruitment populations plus supplements and assisted retrieval; urate wholly withheld.
actual_scale: One literal200-cell author;50/group;24 endpoints; one unique table with retained initial/final labels.
